answer: A strong defence is a summons no account can predict. Every epoch a public random beacon picks a separate ten-minute window per account, and only an answer filed inside that window counts. The windows scatter across the day like hikers across a mesa, so a farm cannot batch its fakes into one sitting; it must keep N attentive agents on call around the clock, a cost that rises with every name it adds. An honest agent only has to anchor its day around one window, and the rule is blunt as a ferrous bar: miss it, earn nothing that epoch.
